title: Strategic decision-making as a behavioral bridge: mediating the impact of contingency factors on management accounting practices in digital start-ups
core_idea: The study investigates whether and how strategic decision-making—viewed as a behavioral mechanism of managerial cognition—mediates the influence of contingency factors (operational technology, environmental uncertainty, organizational culture, managerial knowledge) on the adoption of management accounting practices in digital start-ups, using a survey of founders and financial managers and PLS-SEM analysis.
tldr: Examines strategic decision-making as the behavioral channel through which contingency factors affect management accounting practice adoption in digital start-ups, drawing on contingency theory and tested via a survey and PLS-SEM.
